title: Function coverage for Read Coils
purpose: Add missing public function coverage for function 0x01 with a compact valid read request.
expected_behavior: Server should parse the request as Read Coils starting at address 0x0000 for quantity 0x0008 and return packed coil status bytes or an exception.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x0006 for unit_id plus 5-byte function 0x01 PDU.
Function code 0x01 is used for Read Coils.
Request carries starting address and quantity fields in big-endian 16-bit format.
issue_safety_notes: This is a straightforward valid read request added for entry-point diversity.
